tables.name: Merchant Overflow
tables.description: Whether merchants without a stall may sell outside town, along the major roads or out through the main gates. Modifies Law Enforcement.

results.name: Banned
results.description: Excess vendors are not allowed to set up stalls outside the town. Town guards will enforce this. (+1 to law enforcement roll)

results.name: Unpatrolled
results.description: Excess vendors are allowed to set up stalls but, as the town guard do not patrol or monitor these areas, the risk is higher. The spaces available are unkempt.

results.name: Monitored
results.description: Excess vendors are allowed to set up stalls, and the town guard patrols through regularly, but the areas themselves are less-maintained and traffic is lighter.

results.name: Encouraged
results.description: Excess vendors are encouraged to set up stalls outside the town, if they are unable to get a spot in the square. There are maintained areas available for use, and provided on a first-come, first-served basis. When in use by vendors, this area is regularly patrolled, if law enforcement personnel can be spared.
